elements.name: Darkvision
elements.desc: See in dim light within 60 feet as if bright, and in darkness as if dim.

elements.name: Dwarven Resilience
elements.desc: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.

elements.name: Dwarven Toughness
elements.desc: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per level.

elements.name: Keen Senses
elements.desc: You have proficiency in Perception.

elements.name: Fey Ancestry
elements.desc: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep.

elements.name: Trance
elements.desc: You meditate 4 hours instead of sleeping 8.

elements.name: Lucky
elements.desc: When you roll a 1 on an attack, check or save, reroll it and use the new roll.

elements.name: Brave
elements.desc: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

elements.name: Halfling Nimbleness
elements.desc: You can move through the space of any larger creature.

elements.name: Naturally Stealthy
elements.desc: You can hide behind a creature at least one size larger than you.

elements.name: Dwarf
elements.desc: Bold and hardy. +2 Constitution, speed 25 ft.

elements.name: Hill Dwarf
elements.desc: +1 Wisdom, plus Dwarven Toughness.

elements.name: Elf
elements.desc: Graceful and long-lived. +2 Dexterity, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: High Elf
elements.desc: +1 Intelligence.

elements.name: Halfling
elements.desc: Small and nimble. +2 Dexterity, speed 25 ft.

elements.name: Lightfoot Halfling
elements.desc: +1 Charisma, plus Naturally Stealthy.

elements.name: Human
elements.desc: Versatile. +1 to every ability, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Strength
elements.desc: Your Strength score increases by 1.

elements.name: Dexterity
elements.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

elements.name: Constitution
elements.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

elements.name: Intelligence
elements.desc: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

elements.name: Wisdom
elements.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

elements.name: Breath Weapon
elements.desc: Action: exhale destructive energy based on your draconic ancestry (2d6, Dexterity or Constitution save), once per short rest.

elements.name: Draconic Damage Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to the damage type of your draconic ancestry.

elements.name: Gnome Cunning
elements.desc: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves against magic.

elements.name: Artificer's Lore
elements.desc: Add double your proficiency bonus to History checks about magic items, alchemical objects or technological devices.

elements.name: Tinker
elements.desc: Spend 1 hour and 10 gp to build a tiny clockwork device (clockwork toy, fire starter or music box).

elements.name: Skill Versatility
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

elements.name: Menacing
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

elements.name: Relentless Endurance
elements.desc: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed, drop to 1 hit point instead, once per long rest.

elements.name: Savage Attacks
elements.desc: On a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one of the weapon damage dice one additional time.

elements.name: Hellish Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to fire damage.

elements.name: Infernal Legacy
elements.desc: You know thaumaturgy, and gain hellish rebuke at 3rd level and darkness at 5th, using Charisma.

elements.name: Black Dragon
elements.desc: Acid damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft line, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Blue Dragon
elements.desc: Lightning damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft line, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Brass Dragon
elements.desc: Fire damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft line, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Bronze Dragon
elements.desc: Lightning damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft line, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Copper Dragon
elements.desc: Acid damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft line, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Gold Dragon
elements.desc: Fire damage. Breath weapon: 15 ft cone, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Green Dragon
elements.desc: Poison damage. Breath weapon: 15 ft cone, Constitution save.

elements.name: Red Dragon
elements.desc: Fire damage. Breath weapon: 15 ft cone, Dexterity save.

elements.name: Silver Dragon
elements.desc: Cold damage. Breath weapon: 15 ft cone, Constitution save.

elements.name: White Dragon
elements.desc: Cold damage. Breath weapon: 15 ft cone, Constitution save.

elements.name: Dragonborn
elements.desc: Born of dragons. +2 Strength, +1 Charisma, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Gnome
elements.desc: Small and curious. +2 Intelligence, speed 25 ft.

elements.name: Rock Gnome
elements.desc: +1 Constitution, plus Artificer’s Lore and Tinker.

elements.name: Half-Elf
elements.desc: Walking in two worlds. +2 Charisma and +1 to two other abilities, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Half-Orc
elements.desc: Fierce and strong. +2 Strength, +1 Constitution, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Tiefling
elements.desc: Touched by the Nine Hells. +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Smith’s tools
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with Smith’s tools.

elements.name: Brewer’s supplies
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with Brewer’s supplies.

elements.name: Mason’s tools
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with Mason’s tools.
